features: Two-Way Street: The wireless mouse allows you to connect 2 ways - with 2.4 GHz (via USB Nano dongle) and Bluetooth 5.0. Toad II Wireless Mouse works for a range of up to 10 metres.
Multiple Device Pairing: This wireless mouse allows you to pair with one device via the 2.4 GHz USB Nano Dongle and up to two devices via Bluetooth.
Modify DPI: Toad II allows you to switch conveniently between Optical Tracking up to 1600 DPI. Toad II gives you the best of professional, academic and casual experiences.
Universal Compatibility: The mouse wireless is compatible with most operating systems like Windows, macOS. It is the perfect accessory to be used as a Bluetooth mouse for laptops.

Clever Design: The 5-button design with a left-right click, scroll wheel, DPI button and another button to switch between connections and devices (2.4 GHz and Bluetooth 5.0). The USB nano dongle fits in a slot designed inside the wireless mouse.
